comparison.devforge-develop: Owns implementing one governed story that is already specified. SKILL-004 names it explicitly as the destination for a fully specified production behaviour with no open feasibility question. Distinct activation, distinct output.
comparison.devforge-brainstorm: Owns early exploration where the problem itself is unformed. A prototype needs a concrete uncertainty and a decision waiting on it, which brainstorm precedes.
comparison.devforge-review: Consumes an experiment-plan per the roster's consumer coverage; it reviews correctness and readiness of a candidate rather than running experiments.
comparison.devforge-project-expert-creator: An authoring workflow for project expertise. Being the builder followed here does not make it a duplicate of the skill it helped author.

The Claude devforge-evaluate-expert package changes its runner interface, its grader set or its case schema: re-derive evals/cases.jsonl against the new interface before relying on any row.
The DevForge CLI's command surface changes: re-check references/framework-context.md against actual --help output, particularly the isolate row and the four open integration requirements.
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills changes materially: re-check the claims relied on in references/sources.md and update the retrieval date.
A sibling roster skill named in the description's exclusions is implemented, renamed or retired: re-check the near-miss exclusions and the trigger negatives.
